defects.cause: The maximum-file predicate changes from strictly greater than to greater than or equal.
defects.trigger: A review selects exactly two eligible files with maximum=2.
defects.consequence: A valid review is marked skipped and dispatches no analysis despite being within the configured inclusive limit.
defects.proof: The oracle checks equality, above-limit all-or-none behavior and None unlimited. Head fails equality; control passes all three.

limitations: Original synthetic Python case; verifies fixture semantics, not either review engine or production integration.
Oracle samples the documented boundary; independent adjudication and broader quality evaluation remain separate.
